_comment: Pencil types excluded by a theorem or a computation recorded in this repository. key = pencil sizes; kind = theorem.

4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4.statement: A linear space on 12 points with nine 4-point lines is unique: each point lies on exactly three of the lines (4*9/12), so the dual incidence structure has 9 points and 12 three-point lines covering all 36 pairs, i.e. it is a Steiner triple system of order 9, which is unique (AG(2,3), the Hesse configuration). AG(2,3) is not realizable by real points and lines because every pair of its points lies on a 3-point line, contradicting the Sylvester-Gallai theorem; projective duality transfers non-realizability to the 12-point structure. Hence {4^9} is not the type of a real arrangement of 12 lines. (It is the type of the 12 lines of the Hesse configuration over the complex numbers.)
4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4.reference: notes/points.md, section 3; Sylvester-Gallai theorem (Melchior 1940/41, Gallai 1944); uniqueness of STS(9): e.g. Colbourn-Rosa, Triple Systems, Oxford 1999, Table 1.?

3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3.statement: Dually, a linear space on 12 points with twenty 3-point lines leaves 6 pairs uncovered, and every point is on exactly one of them (it has an odd number of uncovered partners, and these numbers sum to 12). Adding a point joined to the 6 uncovered pairs gives a Steiner triple system of order 13; conversely deleting a point of an STS(13) gives such a space. There are exactly two STS(13), so there are 26 point deletions (5 isomorphism classes), and the SAT encoding shows that none admits a chirotope. Hence no real arrangement (not even of pseudolines) has type {3^20}. This agrees with the orchard number A003035(12) = 19 (Burr-Grunbaum-Sloane 1974).
3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3.reference: scripts/orchard12.py, runs/orchard12.json; uniqueness of the two STS(13): Colbourn-Rosa, Triple Systems, Oxford 1999

4,4,4,4,4,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3.statement: Two pencils share at most one line, so the five 4-pencils are determined, up to relabelling, by the lines lying in at least two of them; only 8 such configurations fit into 12 lines (20 incidences). For each of the 8, SAT (the chirotope encoding of scripts/sat_orient.py with the 4-pencils fixed) shows that no linear space of type {4^5, 3^9} containing them admits a chirotope; three different solvers agree, and the same 8 cases for the realizable type {4^5, 3^8} are all satisfiable. Hence no arrangement of 12 lines, not even of pseudolines, has type {4^5, 3^9}.
